attempts.text: [{"name":"cobuy","idea":"Pairs of items that are carted or ordered together in the same history session (sessions with 2 to 30 such items), counted by distinct sessions, as a buy-to-buy co-visitation for cart and order recall.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH b AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), bs AS (SELECT session FROM b GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), bb AS (SELECT b.session, b.item, b.o FROM b JOIN bs ON b.session = bs.session), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, y.item AS item2, count(*) AS n, sum(y.o) AS n_o FROM bb x JOIN bb y ON x.session = y.session AND x.item <> y.item GROUP BY x.item, y.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, n, n_o, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY n DESC, n_o DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS tv_n, CAST(n_o AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ord FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"},{"name":"view2buy","idea":"Directed pairs where an item first viewed earlier in a history session is followed by a different item that is carted or ordered later in that session, so viewed items point to likely purchases.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH c AS (SELECT session, item, min(seq) AS cs, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM hist WHERE event IN ('cart', 'order') GROUP BY session, item), css AS (SELECT DISTINCT session FROM c), v AS (SELECT h.session, h.item, min(h.seq) AS fs FROM hist h JOIN css ON h.session = css.session WHERE h.event = 'view' GROUP BY h.session, h.item), vn AS (SELECT session FROM v GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) <= 40), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, c.item AS item2, count(*) AS n, sum(c.o) AS n_o FROM v x JOIN vn ON x.session = vn.session JOIN c ON c.session = x.session AND x.fs < c.cs AND x.item <> c.item GROUP BY x.item, c.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, n, n_o, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY n DESC, n_o DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS tv_n, CAST(n_o AS DOUBLE) AS tv_ord FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"},{"name":"nextview","idea":"Forward transitions in the last 7 days of history after collapsing consecutive repeats: item2 appearing 1 to 3 steps after item, weighted 1/step, to predict the next viewed item.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH e AS (SELECT session, item, seq, lag(item) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS pi FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400), d AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq, item) AS r FROM e WHERE pi IS NULL OR pi <> item), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, y.item AS item2, sum(1.0 / k.k) AS w FROM d x CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) k(k) JOIN d y ON y.session = x.session AND y.r = x.r + k.k WHERE y.item <> x.item GROUP BY x.item, y.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, w, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY w DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(w AS DOUBLE) AS tv_w FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"},{"name":"covisit_w","idea":"Symmetric whole-session co-occurrence in the last 7 days of history (sessions with 2 to 20 distinct items), with item2 weighted by its strongest event type (view 1, cart 6, order 3), to surface items that get bought alongside.","kind":"table","level":"item_pair","sql":"WITH b AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 6 WHEN event = 'order' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) AS w FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 7*86400 GROUP BY session, item), bs AS (SELECT session FROM b GROUP BY session HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 20), bb AS (SELECT b.session, b.item, b.w FROM b JOIN bs ON b.session = bs.session), p AS (SELECT x.item AS item, y.item AS item2, sum(y.w) AS w FROM bb x JOIN bb y ON x.session = y.session AND x.item <> y.item GROUP BY x.item, y.item), r AS (SELECT item, item2, w, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY item ORDER BY w DESC, item2) AS rn FROM p) SELECT item, item2, CAST(w AS DOUBLE) AS tv_w FROM r WHERE rn <= 50;"},{"name":"wk_next","idea":"Fresh in-week transitions: for the last 3 prefix events of a session, the items that follow those items 1 to 3 steps later in any target-week prefix, weighted 1/step and 1/recency rank, excluding the session's own prefix items.","kind":"source","level":"pair","sql":"WITH l AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS rk FROM sess s JOIN sessions b ON s.session = b.session), li AS (SELECT session, item, min(rk) AS rk FROM l WHERE rk <= 3 GROUP BY session, item), it AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), occ AS (SELECT s.session, s.seq, s.item FROM sess s JOIN it ON s.item = it.item), nx AS (SELECT o.item AS item, n.item AS item2, sum(1.0 / d.k) AS w FROM occ o CROSS JOIN (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) d(k) JOIN sess n ON n.session = o.session AND n.seq = o.seq + d.k WHERE n.item <> o.item GROUP BY o.item, n.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, nx.item2 AS item, sum(nx.w / li.rk) AS score FROM li JOIN nx ON nx.item = li.item GROUP BY li.session, nx.item2), f AS (SELECT sc.session, sc.item, sc.score FROM sc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sess p WHERE p.session = sc.session AND p.item = sc.item)), r AS (SELECT session, item, score, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY score DESC, item) AS rn FROM f) SELECT session, item, CAST(score AS DOUBLE) AS score FROM r WHERE rn <= 40;"}]
